t: Accufit self-adhesive template for quick and accurate installation. Adjustable power, closing speed and backcheck for the perfect closing action. Fits the 2003 footprint to aid upgrade. Universal fixings allow for regular, transom or parallel mount fitting. Suitable for doors up to 1100mm wide and up to 80kg. Ideal for high usage areas such as living accommodation and offices.
